name: Dueling Companions
body:
School illusion (figment); Level antipaladin 1, bloodrager 1, lathspell 1, legendary ninja 1, magus 1, paladin 1, ranger 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You cast the spell and illusory copies of yourself protect you from the directions you are not facing. For the duration, you have a +2 dodge bonus to AC vs. attacks of opportunity and cannot be flanked by creatures with hit dice less than 4 + the caster level of this spell.
